regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, defensive/healthcare-led tape: Big Pharma is the eligible headline with full breadth and high durability, but also a crowded flag (z=1.5). The one validated edge (trend gate) is intact on this history (gate_helps=true), so eligible high-durability themes are the tolerable canvas, while anything ineligible is off trend-discipline. AI/semiconductor themes carry the top raw rank but are ALL ineligible — that means the highest momentum score (Memory/HBM) has breadth 0.0 and is disqualified by the trend gate, so the detector provides no clean leadership there.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed leadership handoff FROM the crowded healthcare/defensive block TO the trend-gated, uncrowded US Energy Complex. The watch retires if XLE sustains a higher 10-day relative return than XLV for five consecutive sessions while breadth in the energy complex rises above 0.3.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only eligible near-top theme combining the detector's one validated leg (absolute-trend gate: eligible=true) with strong durability (0.84) and perfect breadth (1.0). This is a durable, trend-confirmed leadership pocket, but the crowded flag (z=1.5) is a size-down caution — not a reason to expect more upside. Lean is direction-only and humbly expressed: the detector does not predict returns.
theses.dissent: Crowding is high (z=1.5), and thematic inflows/attention spikes historically mark tops rather than entries. With the macro backdrop showing a full unscheduled-surprise share, a single policy or drug-pricing headline could rapidly unwind the crowded defensive bid.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its 50-day average and stays there for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW shares the same trend-gated, high-durability (0.78) profile as Big Pharma and is also crowded (z=1.55), but with a broader equal-weight skew. The trend gate and strong breadth (0.883) support a defensive lean; crowding is a caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Both the headline pharma theme and its sector proxy are simultaneously crowded — if this is one crowded defensive complex, a de-risking rotation would hit both at once, and XLV's pharma-heavy composition offers little diversification from PPH here.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by more than 3% over any rolling 5-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is trend-gated (eligible=true) with a trend hurst tag, yet is NOT crowded (z=0.41) and carries zero breadth (0.0) — meaning the composite is moving without broad participation. The trend gate supports the lean, but near-zero breadth makes this fragile: strength is concentrated and could reverse quickly.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.0 means no participation under the surface; the theme's apparent strength is driven by a very narrow set of names. If energy prices roll over, there is no internal support and the trend can break quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day average and breadth fails to improve above 0.25 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
